snippet.title: United in Stormwind Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome, weary adventurers, to Stormwind, the proud capital of the Alliance! Stormwind is a bustling city full of merchants, quest-givers, and… hidden evils? Trade for some new gear, grab a mount, and gather your allies to stand together, United in Stormwind!
United in Stormwind launches worldwide on August 3 with 135 new collectible cards, the new Tradeable keyword, Questlines, mounts, profession tools, and more!

Learn more about United in Stormwind: https://playhearthstone.com/news/23689677 

See United in Stormwind Card Reveals: https://playhearthstone.com/cards 

Read the 20.8 Patch Notes: https://playhearthstone.com/news/23686109
